      The E6 Link Intervenors file these proposed corrections to Attachment B to

SOAH’s Order No. 30:

      1.     The E6 Link Intervenors are listed as Party No. 117 on Attachment A to

SOAH Order No. 30. On Attachment B, only Misty Hoenig is listed as Party No. 117. All

a full list of incorrectly listed intervenors.

incorrectly. It is currently spelled as Hoeing should be Hoenig.
